concerns.text: FR-001 requires a deterministic Python verification script for every puzzle. Tasks T014c-impl and T014c-exec (generate_and_validate) are unimplemented, leaving the core dataset validation pipeline (checksumming, distribution reporting) without an execution path. T011 and T012 exist but the orchestration to validate the full dataset is missing.

FR-004 and FR-005 require recording computational costs (energy) and applying a two-proportion z-test. Tasks T027 (metrics), T027b (z-test), and T043a (z-test logic) are unimplemented. Additionally, T008c (TDP constant generation) is unimplemented, blocking the energy calibration data required for FR-004.

FR-003 requires executing the BES forward step with a CPU-tractable LLM. Task T021 (forward_step implementation) is unimplemented. Task T023 (backward_step integration) is unimplemented. The core experimental loop cannot function without these.

SC-005 requires measuring computational complexity class (O(n), etc.). Tasks T029d-derive and T029g (complexity analysis) are unimplemented. Prerequisite scaling logs (T029c-gen) cannot be generated because the BES loop (T021, T023) is not implemented.
SC-001 requires pre-registering the statistical framework. Tasks T028a (pre-registration logic) and T028b (execution) are unimplemented, leaving the statistical validity undefined.

Constitution Principle VII requires comparing CPU-seconds vs. estimated GPU-hours. Tasks T040b (literature factor generation) and T040c (conversion logic) are unimplemented, meaning the plan's mitigation strategy is not coded.

FR-006 requires excluding puzzles if the symbolic planner fails. Task T036 (validation gate) and T014e-exec (distribution validation) are unimplemented, meaning the 'Fail Loudly' gate for the dataset will never run.

Tasks T001a, T001b, T001c, T004, T002a, and T002b (directory setup, git init, venv) are marked unimplemented. These are prerequisites for US1 (T011, T012), creating a logical deadlock where foundational infrastructure is missing.

Task T017b has a comment 'FAILED: unspecified' but is marked [X] (completed). This is a stale/inconsistent tag indicating a task that claims completion but references a failure state without resolution.
